title: Pablo Exclusive Tropical Punch Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Escape to the tropics with Pablo Exclusive Tropical Punch Nicotine Pouches. A vibrant explosion of exotic fruits, this flavour combines the sweetness of mango and pineapple with zesty citrus undertones for a truly sunshine-filled experience. Beneath the bright flavour lies a serious 30mg/g nicotine strength, crafted for experienced users who demand the best in potency and performance. The slim, tobacco-free pouches offer a discreet way to enjoy a powerful kick without compromise. The perfect balance of exotic flavour and extreme satisfaction. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
